## What's Changed

### Security fixes

 2.15.0 fixes four vulnerabilities. The fetch-guard and event-stream fixes affect every v2 release from 2.0.0 through 2.14.0, the mcpdo daemon fix affects 2.10.0 through 2.14.0, and the server.json preview fix affects 2.14.0. Upgrade with `npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@latest`.

* **The fetch guard blocks cloud metadata addresses outside `169.254.0.0/16`**, including `100.100.100.200` and `192.0.0.192` and their decimal and IPv4-mapped IPv6 forms, so neither the `/api/fetch` proxy nor OAuth discovery can be pointed at them ([GHSA-fvg8-f358-w2c8](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/security/advisories/GHSA-fvg8-f358-w2c8))
* **The network tracker caps the body it records for a POST event-stream response**, so a server streaming an unbounded response can no longer exhaust the web backend's memory and take down every session ([GHSA-9w48-x22j-rrm7](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/security/advisories/GHSA-9w48-x22j-rrm7))
* **The server.json launch preview shows every environment variable's value**, flags runtime-control variables such as `NODE_OPTIONS` and `npm_config_registry` with a warning, and requires confirmation before the server can be added ([GHSA-pp85-586h-2m95](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/security/advisories/GHSA-pp85-586h-2m95))
* **`mcpdo` verifies the connection daemon before sending it anything**: the daemon must prove it holds this user's token, so an impostor listening on the daemon's socket or pipe receives no credentials ([GHSA-5572-x678-xmv8](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/security/advisories/GHSA-5572-x678-xmv8))

### Other changes

* docs(security-advisory): land GHSA fixes through ordinary public PRs by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2886

* fix(cli,mcpdo): send --prompt-args values verbatim as strings by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2890
* chore(deps): override minimatch to ^11 to clear GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2895
* fix(cli): stop variadic options swallowing a target placed after them by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2892
* Surface OAuth fetch-guard refusals even when discovery falls back by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2893
* chore(deps): report a stale Dockerfile base-image digest in the monthly sweep by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2900
* feat(tui,mcpdo): decode and show access-token claims by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2891
* feat(web): per-tool run history with re-run and diff by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2894
* fix: make local:gate pass on Windows, verified by a new Windows CI job (#2748) by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2906
* feat(cli,mcpdo): --oauth-debug traces each OAuth step to stderr by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2902
* TUI: handle sampling and elicitation requests from the server by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2903
* feat(web): list and terminate active backend sessions by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2901
* feat(load): --load-scenario weighted mix of tools, resources and prompts by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2896
* feat(load): argument placeholders and --load-args-file so calls are not identical by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2908
* feat(load): stepped and ramped load to find a server's knee by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2909
* feat(load): bounded-memory latency histogram, p95/p99.9, and p50/p95/throughput gates by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2915
* feat(load): progress lines, --load-interval time series and --load-warmup by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2916
* feat(load): per-call NDJSON samples, a readable text summary and open-loop mode by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2917
* mcpdo: relay destination-guard refusal warnings from the detached sign-in helper by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2918
* TUI: multi-select for array-of-choices form fields (#2904) by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2919
* fix(core): keep a URL-valued secret whole in embedded-URL redaction by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2920
* feat(load): --load-baseline and --load-max-regression by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2921
* feat(load): --load-churn session churn mode by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2923
* chore(deps): upgrade @modelcontextprotocol/ext-tasks to 0.2.3 by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2925
* fix(core): terminate the Streamable HTTP session on disconnect by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2926
* feat(load): --load-subscribe notification fan-out load by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2927
* feat(web): load-test panel on the shared --load engine by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2929
* perf(web): stop re-rendering the page on every MCP message by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2931
* feat(load): --load-workers multi-process load generator by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2930
* Web: mount monitoring-sidebar rows only near the viewport (#2932) by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2933
* CLI: classify OAuth and fetch-guard failures instead of exiting 1 (#2842) by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2940
* v2: Block cloud metadata addresses outside 169.254.0.0/16 in the fetch guard (GHSA-fvg8-f358-w2c8) by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2942
* Fix flaky SkillsScreen verdict-count assertions (#2941) by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2952
* Cap the fetch tracker's recorded response body (GHSA-9w48-x22j-rrm7) by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2944
* Show env values in the server.json launch preview and confirm runtime-control vars by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2945
* mcpdo: authenticate the daemon to the client before sending anything (GHSA-5572-x678-xmv8) by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2946
* Release 2.15.0 step 1: bump version to 2.15.0 by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2957
* Docker: bump the node:22-slim base-image digest by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2966
* chore(release): merge v2/main into main for v2.15.0 by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2961


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/compare/2.14.0...2.15.0
**Smoke test ledger for milestone branch**: [v2/chore/milestone-merge-v2.15.0](https://claude.ai/artifact/47paChMbYVYyf8kPGg2apT)
